column_description: TEXT. Primary key uniquely identifying each organs donor in the transplant matching system. PK = Demographics(Contrib_Registry). Example: D812743.
TEXT. Donor's age in years at time of organs recovery. Example: 57 years, mature donor.
TEXT. Donor's ABO blood type classification for compatibility matching. Possible values: AB- rare negative type.
TEXT. Donor's country of origin or nationality reference. Example: Seychelles.

JSONB column. Groups physical measurements and characteristics including height, weight, BMI, and demographic information for donor assessment.
Fields: {"Bmi_Value":"REAL. Donor's calculated body mass index value. Example: 18.8.","Ethnicity":"TEXT. Donor's ethnic or racial background classification. Possible values: African, Asian, Caucasian, Hispanic, Other.","Gender_Type":"TEXT. Donor's gender classification code. Possible values: F, M.","Height_Cm":"SMALLINT.
